scripts.wasm: wasm-pack build crates/game-web --target bundler --release --out-dir ../../pkg --out-name brainrot_game_web && node scripts/fix-wasm-package.mjs
scripts.build:preview: pnpm validate:content && pnpm validate:assets && pnpm wasm && rsbuild build
scripts.build:miniapp: pnpm validate:content && pnpm validate:assets && pnpm wasm && pnpm build:miniapp:desktop && pnpm build:miniapp:quickjs && pnpm build:miniapp:assemble && pnpm verify:package
scripts.build: pnpm build:preview && pnpm build:miniapp && pnpm check:size
scripts.build:watch: pnpm validate:content && pnpm validate:assets && pnpm wasm && rslib build --watch
scripts.dev: pnpm validate:content && pnpm wasm && rsbuild dev
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && node --test src/*.test.mjs && node scripts/validate-assets.mjs
